definitions.explanation: A humble term used to refer to one's own company when speaking to clients, business partners, or other external parties. Standard in business correspondence and formal communication.

examples.japanese: {弊社|へいしゃ}の{製品|せいひん}をご{利用|りよう}いただきありがとうございます。
examples.english: Thank you for using our company's products.

examples.japanese: {弊社|へいしゃ}では{来月|らいげつ}から{新|あたら}しいサービスを{開始|かいし}いたします。
examples.english: Our company will begin a new service starting next month.

examples.japanese: ご{不明|ふめい}な{点|てん}がございましたら、{弊社|へいしゃ}までお{問|と}い{合|あ}わせください。
examples.english: If you have any questions, please contact our company.

notes:
USAGE:
A humble ({謙譲語|けんじょうご}) term used exclusively in business contexts when referring to one's own company to outsiders. Essential in business emails, letters, and formal meetings. Never used for someone else's company.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {当社|とうしゃ}: our company — neutral/formal, used in internal documents or press releases. Less humble than {弊社|へいしゃ}
- {御社|おんしゃ}: your company — the honorific counterpart, used when addressing someone else's company in writing
- {貴社|きしゃ}: your company — honorific, used in formal writing (more formal than {御社|おんしゃ})

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弊社|へいしゃ}の{製品|せいひん} (our company's products)
- {弊社|へいしゃ}では (at our company)
- {弊社|へいしゃ}まで (to our company)
